verdict.line: You lose if you walk into range for her W (Ki Burst) and E (Valor) before your own E is out; you win almost every exchange where Test of Spirit lands first and you back off while it ticks.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit, 900 range) outranges every tool Riven has to punish it — Q (Broken Wings, 275), W (Ki Burst, 260), and E (Valor, 250) — so she can force the spirit out, walk backward, and let the echo do free damage without ever entering Riven's stun or dash range. That range gap is why Illaoi wins this matchup 56.1% over 378 games despite Riven's burst looking scary on paper.

theirWindow.when: Her W and E are both off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Ki Burst (260 range) into Valor (250 range) is her real all-in, not Q — if she has both up and is walking toward you, disengage or pre-emptively land E from max range instead of trading autos.

yourWindow.when: Test of Spirit has just landed
yourWindow.what: Kite away while continuing to auto or Q; the spirit standing next to her echoes a percentage of any damage you deal back onto Riven, so you profit from the trade without ever entering her 250-275 range dash kit.

boots.why: 54.8% WR over 310 games; flat damage reduction blunts Riven's Runic Blade-empowered autos and her Q/W physical burst specifically.

core.why: Highest-WR path into this matchup (74.4% over 43 games) — armor shred lets your tentacle and Q damage punch through her early armor stacking.
Adds a slow proc on-hit, which matters because Riven has no hard CC outside Ki Burst's 260 range — you can kite her Q charges out with a slow attached.
The bonus health and tenacity-adjacent survivability answer her Blade of the Exile all-in windows at level 6/11/16.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-WR page for this matchup (59.1% over 42.5% pick share) — the bonus health and proc damage reward the sustained short trades that Test of Spirit's range advantage creates.

playing.title: Never engage with Q or W first
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup holds: Riven can dodge your Q (Tentacle Smash) or W (Harsh Lesson) through her own Q or E. Walk up and land E (Test of Spirit, 900 range) first instead — it's the one tool she cannot avoid at range.

playing.title: Kite once the spirit is out
playing.detail: After E lands, back off while continuing to auto or poke with Q. The spirit echoes a percentage of damage back onto Riven, so you keep winning the trade without stepping into her 250-275 range kit.

playing.title: Track her Broken Wings charges
playing.detail: Q (Broken Wings) can be recast up to three times in a short window, the third knocking back. If she's already burned charges chasing or poking, she has no gap-closer until the 13s cooldown resets — that's your window to walk up and reapply E.

playing.title: Respect the Ki Burst stun radius
playing.detail: W (Ki Burst) is a 260-range stun, not a skillshot to juke around. Hold outside that range whenever her E (Valor, 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown) is also up, since Valor into Ki Burst is her actual all-in, not Q.

playing.title: Hold R for her Blade of the Exile
playing.detail: Her R grants bonus AD, range, and a single Wind Slash on a 120/90/60/60/10s cooldown. When it's up, keep your own R (Leap of Faith, 450 range) ready to answer — it also spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits, swinging the fight back immediately.

playing.title: Fight near terrain
playing.detail: Tentacles from your passive spawn on nearby impassable terrain and swing at spirits, Vessels, and W (Harsh Lesson) victims. Pull skirmishes toward lane walls so more tentacles proc and heal you when they connect.

playing.title: Chase to force the Vessel conversion
playing.detail: If the spirit's target dies or gets too far away, they become a Vessel and start spawning tentacles on their own. If Riven tries to run off a losing trade, a short W (Harsh Lesson, 400 range, 4s cooldown) chase can trigger this instead of letting her reset for free.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reading — why the range gap on E wins the lane, how to play around her charge and stun windows — is my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: The victor of the engagement will depend on whether [E] lands successfully or not. We recommend not using abilities first as Riven can easily dodge them through (Q) or (E), but rather using [E] while kiting from a distance.
